subject: social_studies
concept: Applying international cooperation, global trade, global challenges, technology, human rights, and local-global connection to a real-world project, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student designs a simple local project idea that connects to addressing a larger global issue
exercise.abstract: Student explains how their project idea connects local action to the larger global issue it addresses

assessment.mastery_threshold: project idea has a genuine, specific connection to a real global issue
misconception_flags: proposes a project with no real connection to any actual global issue from this unit

interest_binding: project idea generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
